interpretation: workload_verified/workload_consistent describe configuration agreement only; they do not verify execution, ownership, or benchmark success.
All stage and CreateContainer rows have additivity=do_not_sum. Nested/cumulative/propagated measurements overlap.
Do not subtract aggregate means or percentiles across populations, processes or clocks to invent an unmeasured stage.
A stage statistic describes observed log records; coverage counts distinct owned IDs. Repeated records are exposed, not silently deduplicated.
Missing values remain null, including genuinely absent stages. Zero is included only when explicitly measured.
A short profile does not by itself establish a bottleneck or performance regression.
warnings: Formal sandbox IDs are unavailable: component stages cannot be claimed as the formal benchmark population.
Formal ownership covers 0/100 requested instances; compare coverage with actual benchmark successes.
unknown_phase is reported separately and may include warmup; it is not a formal-only distribution.
Log rotation/truncation/capture gaps were reported; stage coverage may be incomplete.
Collector reported additional capture gaps; inspect evidence_integrity.capture_gaps.
Phase membership is unverified. Component results remain unknown_phase and are NOT a valid formal-only benchmark distribution.

phase_classification.method: No accepted phase map; all unambiguous owned IDs remain unknown
limitations: Declared phases are supplied by the caller, not independently verified against a runner or server.
A structural match does not prove run ownership, warmup boundaries, workload success, or raw-sequence-to-sandbox mapping.
Conflicting original phase membership is excluded from every phase; it is never rescued by a declaration.
No source ownership file is modified.

interpretation: Values retain native metric units. Gauge changes are endpoint changes, not event counts or latency.
Histogram average is delta(sum)/delta(count); bucket quantiles are interpolated estimates with bounds, not exact sample percentiles.
Includes every observation between scrapes (warmup, formal and unrelated work); no sandbox or benchmark phase attribution is inferred.
Two snapshots cannot detect every restart/reset, prove exclusive workload, or recover missing increments. Invalid series are not reset-corrected.
v0.7.1 CreateContainer restore sub-stages and Cubelet workflow durations are logs, not exported latency histograms.
